tagline: Fragrances, flavors, and wellbeing solutions for global brands
hero_kpi_rationale: Key indicator of organic growth in the fragrances and flavors sector, reflecting actual business performance excluding currency effects and acquisitions, despite inflationary and geopolitical pressures.

kpis.name: Revenue growth excluding currency effects
kpis.explanation: Revenue growth excluding currency effects and acquisitions, to measure actual company performance.
kpis.description: In 2023, Givaudan reported organic growth of 4.1%, driven by pricing actions and efficiency measures, offsetting input cost increases.
kpis.signal: Solid organic growth despite inflationary and geopolitical pressures.

kpis.name: Dividend per share
kpis.explanation: Amount paid to shareholders per share each year.
kpis.description: The proposed dividend for 2023 is CHF 68 per share, up 1.5%, reflecting sustainable distribution policy and confidence in cash flow generation.

kpis.name: Net profit
kpis.explanation: Final profit after all expenses and taxes.
kpis.description: 2023 net profit reached CHF 361.3 million, supported by efficient cost management and pricing actions.
kpis.signal: Solid net profit despite inflationary and currency pressures.

kpis.name: Cumulative total shareholder return since IPO
kpis.explanation: Total value created for shareholders since the IPO in 2000, including share appreciation and dividends.
kpis.description: Since its IPO in 2000, Givaudan has generated approximately CHF 30 billion in total shareholder return, with average annual return of 11%.
kpis.signal: Exceptional value creation with average annual return of 11% since 2000.

kpis.name: Available earnings
kpis.explanation: Total amount of profits available for distribution to shareholders or reserves.
kpis.description: Available earnings in 2023 reached CHF 390.2 million (net profit of CHF 361.3M plus carryforward of CHF 28.9M), enabling dividend distribution of CHF 627.9M and contribution to voluntary reserves.
kpis.signal: Rising available earnings enabling generous dividend distribution.

kpis.name: Total assets
kpis.description: Total assets extracted from yfinance over the last 4 years.
kpis.signal: Total assets of EUR 11.86 billion in latest year

kpis.name: Total debt
kpis.description: Total debt extracted from yfinance over the last 4 years.
kpis.signal: Total debt of EUR 4.42 billion in latest year

kpis.name: Cash and equivalents
kpis.description: Cash and equivalents extracted from yfinance over the last 4 years.
kpis.signal: Cash and equivalents of EUR 0.74 billion in latest year

risks.title: Intensifying competition in fragrances and flavors
risks.score_rationale: Risk is mentioned in the context of targeted investments facing active competition, with moderate but recurring language. It reflects a stable trend, typical of a mature and innovative sector.

risks.title: Dependence on natural raw materials
risks.score_rationale: Risk is central to the business model, with frequent mentions of responsible sourcing, biodiversity, and agricultural regeneration. Language is strong and reflects growing strategic concern.

risks.title: Growing regulation of chemical ingredients
risks.score_rationale: Risk is implicit in sustainability commitments and green chemistry initiatives, with cautious but strategic language. It reflects an upward trend linked to global environmental policies.

risks.title: Cybersecurity of customer data and R&D
risks.score_rationale: Although underexplained, risk is inferred from growing digital initiatives (AI, consumer data). Language is discrete but the weight of digital strategy in company positioning suggests high exposure.

risks.title: Intellectual property protection
risks.score_rationale: Risk is central for an innovation-driven company, with implicit but strategic language. It remains stable, reflecting constant vigilance in a high-value sector.

risks.title: Risks related to sustainable supply chains
risks.score_rationale: Risk is highly prioritized, with repeated mentions of responsible sourcing, agricultural regeneration, and due diligence. Language is strong and trend is upward.

risks.title: Integration of strategic acquisitions
risks.score_rationale: Risk is mentioned in costs related to acquisitions and restructuring. Language is measured, but the growth-by-acquisition model makes it relevant.

risks.title: Dependence on specialized olfactory creation talent
risks.score_rationale: Risk is implicit in talent development and leadership programs. Language is positive but reflects structural dependence on rare competencies.

ai_positioning.summary: Givaudan makes no mention of artificial intelligence strategy or initiatives in the provided documents. The company does not position AI as a strategic or operational lever.
